stratified_examples.explanation: The AI response provides a clear, step-by-step guide on how to make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor, directly addressing the user's query. It includes specific instructions, important tips, and necessary prerequisites.
stratified_examples.question: How can I make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To make a site page members-only using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

- Open your Wix Editor and go to **Pages & Menu** on the left side.
- Hover over the page you want to restrict and click the **More Actions** icon.
- Select **Settings**, then go to **Permissions**.
- Choose **Site members** and select **Specific members**.
- Enable the **Members with plan subscriptions** toggle.
- Click **Manage Plans** and check the relevant pricing plans you want to grant access to.
- Click **Apply** to save the changes.

**Important tips:**
- Do not restrict the main (original) Pricing Plans page, but you can restrict other pages where plans are displayed.
- You may also hide the main Pricing Plans page if needed.

This setup requires having the Pricing Plans app and Members Area added to your site beforehand [S1][S2].

stratified_examples.explanation: The AI response provides a clear, step-by-step guide on how to embed a Pinterest widget on a Wix site using the Wix Editor, directly addressing all aspects of the user's query. It also includes relevant context about the discontinuation of the Wix Pinterest Feed app.
stratified_examples.question: How can I embed a Pinterest widget on my Wix site using the Wix Editor?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To embed a Pinterest widget on your Wix site using the Wix Editor, follow these steps:

- Generate the Pinterest widget code from Pinterest for the desired widget type (Board, Pin, Profile, Follow button, or Save button). Make sure to copy both sets of code and combine them by adding the last piece of code to the end of the first before the closing tag.
- In the Wix Editor, click **Add Elements** on the left side.
- Select **Embed Code** and then **Embed HTML**.
- Click **Enter Code** and ensure **Code** is selected under "What do you want to add?".
- Paste the combined Pinterest widget code into the "Add your code here (HTTPS only)" field.
- Click **Apply**.
- Optionally, add alt text describing the embedded content in the "What's in the embed? Tell Google" field.
- Publish your site to make the widget live.

This process allows you to embed Pinterest content directly, as the Wix Pinterest Feed app is no longer available [S1][S2].

stratified_examples.question: How can I connect a domain purchased elsewhere to my Wix site using the recommended method?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To connect a domain purchased elsewhere to your Wix site using the recommended method:

- Use the **name servers connection method**.
- By changing your domain's name servers to Wix's, Wix will host your DNS records.
- Your domain remains registered with your current domain host, so you continue managing billing and contact details there.
- This method ensures that when users type your domain, it directs to your Wix site.
- You can switch connection methods anytime by removing and re-adding the domain in your Wix account.
- Note that domain transfers can take up to 7 days, so connecting via name servers before transferring is advised to avoid downtime.

stratified_examples.question: How can I set up additional Google Workspace business emails from Wix?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To set up additional Google Workspace business emails from Wix, follow these steps:

- Go to the Business Email section in your Wix account.
- Click "Show User Info" on the relevant account.
- Click the "More Actions" icon next to the account you want to set up.
- Select "Set Up User" and sign in to your Google Workspace account.
- Enter your email address and password.
- Navigate to "Users" and click "Add new user."
- Enter the new user's details and optionally set a password.
- Click "Add" to complete the setup.

Note: You must first purchase additional business emails. It can take up to 24 hours for the new user to access Google Workspace services. Billing for additional emails is immediate and aligns with your original subscription renewal date. There is a limit of 300 business emails per domain [S1][S2].

stratified_examples.question: How can I mark a room as 'Not Available' in Wix Hotels?
stratified_examples.candidate_answer:
To mark a room as 'Not Available' in Wix Hotels, follow these steps:

- Go to your dashboard and click the Hotels tab.
- Click the Reservations tab.
- Select the start date on the calendar for the relevant room.
- Drag across to the end date and click "Set as not available."
- Optionally, add a note for your reference.
- Click Save.

Alternatively, you can click "Create New" on the reservation calendar, fill out the required information, and save to mark the room as unavailable.

Note: If you are using the channel manager, marking dates as unavailable will not reduce availability on connected channels. To block availability across channels, use manual reservations instead.

To unblock a room, hover over the grayed-out area on the reservation calendar and click Unblock [S1].
stratified_examples.gt_answer:

3. Click the **Reservations** tab.
4. Click the start date on the calendar for the relevant room.
5. Drag your mouse across and click the end date.
6. Click **Set as not available**.
7. (Optional) Add a note for yourself.
8. Click **Save**.

**Note**: Alternatively, you can mark a room as 'Not Available' by clicking **Create New** on the reservation calendar, filling out the requested information, and clicking **Save**.
